messages:
alex: FYI PR here https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4823 needs sec/privacy review before we can merge. Touches on onprem auth + kube service account token handling. Requesting security + privacy eyes.

maria: Ack, pinging sec review queue. What's the scope? Is this adding any new KMS paths or external network egress? :eyes:

alex: It updates authn/proxy and the KMS path we use for tenant keys (k8s secret -> KMS encrypt). No outbound calls except vault sync to internal KMS. Diff: src/onprem/auth/proxy.go + deploy/helm/onprem-values.yaml

maria: running quick scan now. If the helm values expose any public CIDR or DNS egress we need to gate. Also, mention if you rotated existing keys.

sec-bot: automated-secret-scan: 0 matches. IaC-lint: 1 warning (helm chart templating - missing tolerations). See https://ci.redwood.dev/build/1234

jess: can someone add a brief runbook snippet to the PR for onprem ops? Also need smoke test steps for key rotation rollback.

dave: From infra side, onprem VPC needs the outbound egress set to internal-only. I can schedule a quick egress ACL check in staging tomorrow 09:30 PT. Will block merge until that's green unless we add emergency fallback.

alex: added runbook blurb and a rollback command to the PR:

```
# rollback key alias
kubectl -n redwood set env deployment/auth-proxy KEY_ALIAS=old-key-alias
helm upgrade redwood ./helm/onprem -f values.yaml --reuse-values
```

Also rotated keys in staging already.

maria: Thanks. One policy note: for HSM-backed keys we require customer approval sign-off if keys move between KMS instances. This PR references KMS:projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/tenantRing -> please confirm.

alex: Confirmed it's the same keyring; no migration. We just changed the usage alias.

jess: I can do a functional smoke once infra has ACL check. After that + sec ack I'll approve.

maria: Quick privacy note: ensure logs redact tenant ids in proxy access logs. I see a commit that touches proxy logs, please add a redaction filter.

alex: done, added redaction regex and test. CI passes on unit tests, awaiting infra check + manual smoke.

dave: infra egress check passed in staging at 09:45 PT. No public egress detected.

maria: doing final read. LGTM pending small lint fix in helm values (tolerations). If you add tolerations I'll post formal approval.

alex: added tolerations; pushed. Thanks all :tada: 

jess: approving after smoke in staging done. Will mark PR as ready to merge after wait window (30m) for rollback.

sec-bot: deploy-policy: canary window set to 30m; auto-fallback configured.

alex: merge scheduled in 35m. Thanks everyone.
